subject: Post-discovery: coordinate 30m product briefing with stakeholders
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@kestrel.ai>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@kestrel.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: coordinate 30m product briefing with stakeholders

Hi Lisa / Tom,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great context from your side. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock a 30-minute product briefing that covers the UX, infra constraints, and security questions you raised.

Recap (from our notes):
- Primary goal: reduce inference tail latency for customer-facing agents (95th percentile target ~120ms).
- Current infra: mixed on-prem + cloud GPUS, region stickiness across US/EU.
- Key constraints: strict data residency for logs, SOC2 evidence, and limited ops windows for infra changes.
- Success metric for pilot: 30% reduction in per-token cost while meeting 95p latency SLO.

What we recommend for the 30-min briefing:
- 10 min: product tour (generation, streaming, routing policies)
- 10 min: infra & deployment options (Dedicated pools, Private VPC, KGMs)
- 10 min: security/compliance and pilot next steps (SOC2 artifacts, rollout plan)

Proposed 30-min slots (PT):
- Wed, Jul 11 — 09:30–10:00 PT
- Thu, Jul 12 — 10:30–11:00 PT
- Fri, Jul 13 — 14:30–15:00 PT

Please reply with the slot that works best and who from your side will join (SRE, Prod, Security). I’ve attached the discovery notes and a draft of the MVP priorities so we can tailor the walkthrough.

Attachments: 20280709-discovery-notes.pdf (summary, call notes)

If none of those work, tell me a couple of 30-minute windows and we’ll flex.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0172
